newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to maintain bank aid program in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to maintain bank aid program in 1997 - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government will maintain in 1997 the special credit lines under the PROER program to encourage bank mergers and acquisitions, Folha de Sao Paulo newspaper said on Monday.
The Central Bank believes the program will be necessary next year because the restructuring of the banking sector has not been concluded yet, it added.

The PROER program was expected to expire in December, but Folha de Sao Paulo said there is no need for a special legislation to guarantee the program's renewal. Under the government decree creating the PROER, only the fiscal benefits given to banks that acquire others would end in December.
Since it was created in November 1995, the PROER plan has granted 14.442 billion reais in funds to facilitate bank acquisitions.
